topicTitle: 2.9 Harmful Effects of Smoking on Heart
answer: Smoking damages the heart and blood vessels, speeds clogging and narrowing of coronary arteries, reduces blood flow to the heart and raises heart-attack risk; nicotine also raises blood pressure.
